name: UWISSY DEADMAN Watchdog - system-health.json Freshness Check

assignments.name: heartbeat_status
assignments.value: OK - production chain verified fresh for expected cycle

assignments.name: degraded_status
assignments.value: DEGRADED - one or more lanes report partial/non-fresh data; no heartbeat sent, no alert raised

assignments.name: degraded_note
assignments.value: Document is structurally valid (assembly ok, published, no failed/LKG/unavailable lanes) but at least one lane is degraded or non-fresh. This is visible for review but intentionally does not trigger the failure alert path or the heartbeat path.

assignments.name: alert_note
assignments.value: No notification credential (email/Slack/webhook) is configured on this OVH n8n instance for this workflow. This node produces a labeled, machine-readable failure record only. Configure an alert destination and add a send step here to enable outbound alerting.
